oneSuccessfulLogin.requirement: A newly created or re-armed Trial ID must allow exactly one successful login; after that the Trial is consumed until re-armed.
oneSuccessfulLogin.normalStudentsUnaffected: Normal student accounts continue to support multiple concurrent valid devices.
oneSuccessfulLogin.diagnosis: The current rebuilt public-v2 Student architecture issues signed approximately 8-hour fpt_session cookies and does not perform a per-request D1 student-session lookup. Trial Manager clears legacy session rows and trial_login_consumptions, but that state alone cannot invalidate an already-issued stateless signed cookie or guarantee a single current Trial session across devices.
doNotClaim: Re-arm currently revokes every already-issued public-v2 Trial cookie.
futureFixConstraints: Must be Trial-specific unless owner explicitly changes normal-account session semantics.
Must provide a server-verifiable way for the rebuilt Student runtime to reject stale/second Trial sessions.
Must cover login, subsequent authenticated requests, re-arm, disable, delete and password reset.
Must include two-device and stale-cookie live regression tests.
Do not choose a technical mechanism until the current rebuilt Student source and deployment are freshly traced.

futureChangeProcedure: Read AGENTS.md and this GCH in full.
Freshly prove correct repo, route owner, active deployment/source provenance and bindings/stores.
Classify requested change and enumerate every coupled workflow/data layer.
Record pre-change invariants and preservation ledger items that can be affected.
Trace source/write -> canonical state -> prepared projection -> public API -> browser before editing.
Implement the smallest coherent cross-layer change; do not apply a downstream-only symptom patch when an upstream projection/session contract is broken.
Run targeted tests plus the preservation regression matrix for every shared component touched.
Deploy only through the current capability-preserving path with rollback anchor/binding preservation.
Verify canonical state, prepared state, live API and representative browser behaviour.
For Trial/auth changes, run two-device, stale-cookie, re-arm, disable/delete/reset and exact-ended-copy checks while confirming normal-student multi-device remains intact.
Update this GCH in the same change with new source anchors, decisions, defects closed/opened, preservation requirements and live evidence labels.
Never store passwords, Admin secrets, student private data or Cloudflare credentials in this authority.
stopConditions: Cannot prove the exact live route/version/source required for the change.
Current source and live behaviour disagree without a deployment mapping.
Requested mutation would affect a broader scope than authorised.
A business requirement conflicts with current implementation and no safe coherent change has been defined.
